name: hud_ui_options_panel_sound_volume_on_activate
description: HudUiOptionsPanel_SoundVolume::OnActivate derives the slider value from the cursor, writes the sound-volume option, mirrors it to the global sound scale, and refreshes the fill-bitmap normalized value.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred for the HUD options-panel source-file/table cluster.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x40cc30 calls HudUiFillBitmap::UpdateNormalizedFromCursor, writes self->base.normalizedValue through zOpt::SetSoundVolumeOption, then dispatches SetNormalizedValue with zOpt::GetSoundVolumeOption.

Native smoke zhud_options_panel_sound_volume_on_activate_smoke configures owner cursor X and slider images, verifies OnActivate derives 0.25f, writes ZOPT_SOUND_VOLUME, mirrors g_zSnd_GlobalVolumeScalePtr, rebuilds the fill rectangle, and invalidates the widget.
